The object has a flat, rectangular top surface that appears cracked and worn, supported by legs or a base structure. It does not resemble a standard modern smoothing iron; it looks more like an old, heavy industrial pressing tool, a stone slab, or a piece of debris. There is no visible handle, temperature dial, steam holes, or power cord typical of a consumer iron.
